name: The Knight—石头人太强打不死版
author: zzz9000000
description:
注意调整音量！！！！！！！！进入游戏时会有bgm播放
Pay attention to adjusting the volume!!!!!!!! BGM will play when entering the game.


鼠标：点点点控制小狐狸移动
Mouse: Click to control the movement of the little fox

上下滚轮：调整近远视角
Upper and lower rollers: adjust the near and far viewing angles

Enter键：确定
Enter key: OK

↑↓键：选择button
↑↓ key: Select button

AD键：旋转方向
AD Key: rotation direction

点击石头人扔出的石头可以进行反击！要看你的技术了:3
Click the stone thrown by the stone man to fight back! It depends on your skills:3

S键：保存游戏进度
S Key: save game progress

E键：传送门传送
E Key: portal transmission

Esc键：退出游戏画面进入主菜单
ESC key: exit the game screen and enter the main menu

PS：如果发现游戏过程中画面抖动厉害，可以重新退出游戏再进一次也许就好了.不行的话可以再退出下再进入，实在不行的话只能将就一下惹，能力有限我调整不来:(
PS: if you find that the picture shakes badly during the game, you can quit the game and enter it again.If it can't change, you can quit and enter again. I'm sorry that I can't adjust my ability:(


祝玩的愉快:3
Have a good time:3
